title: Governed Tool Definition
description: Schema every .ai/agents/tools/*.json and .ai/mcp/tools/*.json must satisfy. Enforced by validator + CI. Version this file in lock-step with agent-config.yaml.

schema_version.description: Schema version this tool conforms to. Defaults to '1.0' if absent.

tool_name.description: kebab-case identifier; must match the file basename

safety_level.description: 'variable' is reserved for meta-tools (e.g., apply-safe-change) that classify safety per call; such tools must set requires_approval=true.

inputs.description: Optional JSON-Schema-style input shape for the tool

outputs.description: Optional JSON-Schema-style output shape for the tool

context.description: Free-form context block (string or object) used by generator-style tools.

configuration.description: Free-form configuration block (array of strings or object) used by generator-style tools.

tools_referenced.description: Names of other governed tools this tool composes with.

constraints.description: Free-form constraints block (array of strings or object).

allOf.description: medium / high / variable safety levels must require approval
